Prohibited_Implementation_Patterns: Mutating activeView or activeProjectId in nodeselect/edgeselect handlers
Querying or saving DA_User_Preference__c without User__c scoping
Loading or presenting presets belonging to different DA_Project__c IDs
Overwriting Positions_JSON__c during filter saves or layout switches
Resetting viewport zoom/pan coordinates when applying non-spatial filters
Deleting or dissociating DA_Annotation__c records when toggling layout or filter modes
Creating orphan Cytoscape instances without calling cy.destroy() on disconnectedCallback
Applying payload or preference data without verifying requestId matches active requestId
Splitting multibyte characters or UTF-16 surrogate pairs across chunk boundaries
Direct in-place mutation of payload.nodes or payload.edges by child views
